title: hydroglossum pedatum
intro: Hydroglossum pedatum, commonly known as Cuckoo flower or Lady's fingers, is a flowering plant species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help reduce symptoms of respiratory issues and boost the immune system. Hydroglossum pedatum has therapeutic actions such as being a demulcent and expectorant, helping to soothe and calm irritated tissues in the body while promoting the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
